extracted.name: Homemade Peanut Butter
extracted.description: Learn how to make AMAZING homemade peanut butter! It's super smooth, creamy, and filled with rich peanut flavor. You're going to want to eat it by the spoonful!
ingredient_lines: 3 cups dry roasted & salted or unsalted peanuts
Sea salt (to taste (if using unsalted peanuts))
instruction_lines: Place the peanuts in a medium food processor.* Process until very smooth, stopping every 30 seconds to 1 minute to scape down the sides of the bowl, as necessary, and to give the food processor's motor a break. The mixture will be chunky at first. Then, it'll thicken into a ball, and finally, it will become creamy and smooth. The whole process should take about 8 to 10 minutes.
